synopsis: A world model for interactive games that predicts a structured 3D world state (skeletons, trajectories), then renders geometry and occlusion with a zero-parameter renderer before a diffusion model paints the final appearance, enabling consistent viewpoint changes.

Introduces sMuon, an optimizer that adapts the Muon algorithm to low-rank parameter-efficient fine-tuning by linearizing the objective and solving it with least-squares, offering a practical and efficient alternative for fine-tuning large models.
